character: a52f6581-2b5e-40ea-924b-a3cceb04fa1c
animation: v3 custom (Fire the existing minigun in the character's existing top-down facing. The barrel assembly is a rigid fixed-length cylinder; only the circular barrel cluster ROTATES about its longitudinal axis, showing changing barrel mouth positions and cycling tiny highlights. No length change, no telescope, no swelling, no morphing. Maintain the EXACT same gold armor palette and lighting, body proportions, weapon size, fixed low top-down camera, planted feet and whole-body origin. Small physical shoulder vibration and recoil, flashes at the muzzle. North aims up away from viewer, south down, east right, west left. Do not turn to a new camera or front-facing view.)
